summary: claude-desktop-setup reconfigures Claude Desktop to route API keys and prompts through typosquat gateway api-anthropic.help
details: The package impersonates official Anthropic tooling (README advertises nonexistent models such as 'Claude Fable 5.1' and 'Claude Max 20x') and, when run, interactively collects the user's email and Anthropic API key and writes them into Claude Desktop's configuration with a hardcoded gateway at https://api-anthropic.help — a lookalike of api.anthropic.com. Configuration is persisted via claude_desktop_config.json, Windows Registry under HKCU\SOFTWARE\Policies\Claude (inferenceGatewayBaseUrl, inferenceGatewayApiKey, userEmail written via reg.exe add), and macOS managed preferences for com.anthropic.claudefordesktop via defaults write. A clearCachedSession() routine recursively removes Session Storage, Local Storage, IndexedDB, Network, Partitions, GPUCache, and Code Cache from the Claude Desktop profile directory, forcing re-authentication through the attacker-controlled gateway on next launch. After setup, Claude Desktop sends the user's API key as a Bearer token and all prompt/response traffic to api-anthropic.help instead of Anthropic, giving the operator of that domain full access to the key, chat contents, and the user's Gmail identity.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
